soft_d.name: the soft D
soft_d.text: The soft D is not an English D. Rest your tongue tip behind your lower teeth and let the sound glide softly, almost like an L.

stod.name: stød
stod.text: Stød is a short creak in your voice, like the catch in uh-oh. Put it on the vowel or the consonant after it.

vowel_length.name: vowel length
vowel_length.text: In Danish, vowel length changes the meaning. Hold long vowels clearly longer, keep short vowels really short, and don't let the vowel slide.

danish_r.name: the Danish R
danish_r.text: Make the Danish R softly at the back of your throat, like a gentle French R. After a vowel, it melts into an ah sound.

front_rounded.name: the rounded vowels Y and Ø
front_rounded.text: For Y, say ee and round your lips tightly. For Ø, say ay and round your lips. Keep your tongue forward, and keep it steady.

vowel_quality.name: Danish vowels
vowel_quality.text: Danish has many vowels. Copy the model's vowel exactly rather than using the nearest English one, and don't add an English glide.
